card.name: Sentence starts and early-text positions
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on scattered tokens such as sentence-initial pronouns, a comma after a date, the digit 0 in years, and nav-menu words like Home or Contents.

modes.label: Sentence-initial pronoun
modes.description: A pronoun like It or He opening a sentence that refers back to a subject just described.

modes.label: Menu words in page headers
modes.description: Navigation labels like Home or Contents inside bracketed or piped link bars.
